text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day. Mejiro Bright stood in front of the school gates
with a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Today is a special day off from classes and training at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Right this way, please.
Please, step right aboard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The door of a large black sedan pulled up next to the front gate opens. A driver in a black suit bows deferentially...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu~, it's already decided~.
A second home for you, Trainer-sama.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: —It's the Mejiro estate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—I felt half-dead with nerves. In the center sat
the Mejiro Grand Dame. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume representing the Mejiro family have gathered in full force.
You can tell just from the atmosphere that an important discussion is about to take place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: If you would allow me, I, Mejiro Ardan, will be serving as your host today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The topic was the "new wave"
that had been causing a stir in the Umamusume world these past few years.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In other words, it's about the accelerating trend towards "speed-oriented pacing."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Next slide, please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A trend prioritizing speed."
The video played along with these intriguing words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Until recently, speed and stamina
were valued equally in the world of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However, recently the trend has shifted
heavily toward prioritizing speed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Race times have gotten faster, and training regimens now focus mainly on speed.
To keep up with that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "More and more camps are choosing not to push themselves to target prestigious long-distance races like the Kikuka-sho or the Tenno Sho (Spring)."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“—An unprecedented new era of speed.
And if one were to name the Umamusume
who stands out most among them——”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday-san,
and Special Week-san would be prime examples.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
At times, they exhibit an unknown burst of acceleration
unimaginable by conventional logic.
What's more—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: A similar characteristic seems to have been observed in several Umamusume who won Classic GⅠ races in recent years.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The speed they possess is something
unlike anything seen before, one could say.
Now then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, this time of year would be buzzing with talk
of who will win the Tenno Sho (Spring). However—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trends have shifted slightly,
and the era's focus is leaning toward medium distances.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Today's agenda is how we view this trend
and how we ought to address it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, Trainer-sama...
Things have gotten quite extraordinary, haven't they~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A new era emphasizing speed, and how the Mejiro family
should respond. It was truly a grand council
of a prestigious house.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
From all-round ability to pure speed. That trend had
gradually been building for a long time, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: It might have become more noticeable around the time that Umamusume made her appearance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: Butler. Play the footage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text: —Hah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
—Fuji Kiseki.
An Umamusume who claimed the Junior-class championship
with speed so dazzling it seemed like magic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"Is it truly possible to run like that?"
Many stakeholders were profoundly shocked,
and the pace of change accelerated even further...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
We may not be able to change the overarching tide of the times.
However, how Mejiro ought to carry itself within that current is a different matter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro family's philosophy is that a truly strong Umamusume must be able to win long-distance races, represented by the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Yet, with everyone's training time being limited,
is it really fine to leave everything stuck in the past?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"There is certainly room for debate.
So please, discuss it to your heart's content today, everyone."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
And it would be good for each of us to consider
what kind of family Mejiro should aspire to be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Leaving behind those parting words, Grandmother walked out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I know I need to think about it like Grandmother says, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I don't think you need to worry about it that much?
Everyone has their own goals
and training they need to do, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, if everyone goes super fast and zooms right by,
you might not be able to catch up, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You're right... But even so,
I don't think it's right to change the Mejiro family traditions.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If we simply pander to others, we will only lose our culture.
That is one way to look at it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Then just like Ryan said,
shouldn't we just leave it alone?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even if the fans turn away a bit saying, "That's not how they run nowadays," as long as I pay it no mind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Though that is—assuming I can win, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh, McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even if we simply observe, the culture of racing changes with every passing moment.
It is entirely possible that even the racing system itself could change.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Even if Mejiro wins every long-distance race, if we fall behind in other middle-distance races and the balance of race counts shifts...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Our prestige will surely fade. And people will say,
'The Mejiro family has lost its momentum.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If we cannot defy that public opinion,
we might simply be swept away by the tides of the era...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then should we ride this momentum too?
Like, polishing our speed even further.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That may be true, but it still doesn't quite sit right with me.
I value speed quite a bit too, but at the end of the day,
it's the Mejiro style, so to speak...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A variety of opinions flew back and forth. Because every single
one was sound logic, it was hard to reach a consensus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Amidst all this, Mejiro McQueen's eyes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to ask just for reference.
As the only one here observing the Mejiros from the outside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly put on the spot to speak, a lump rose
in my throat, but I couldn't just remain silent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright gave a gentle smile.
Seeing it gave me courage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright is none other than the true heir to the Mejiro tradition. If the path she has walked and the path she will take as their symbol are indeed the right ones—
choice_data_list: I think you should just stay as you are... and win them all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Everything, just as I am now? Keeping my stamina,
while contending in speed the exact same way?
choice_data_list: That's what I think it means to be a Mejiro, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Indeed, that was the truth. Umamusume of the Mejiro family have conquered every kind of race, both medium and long distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Polishing the usual approach seems to be the best way.
Just as Mejiro Bright does.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see~.
As expected of Bright's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You've got some serious guts!
I bet you'd just laugh even during an earthquake.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Easier said than done," you know.
Trainer-san, do you truly understand?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"For a single Umamusume to achieve that,
she would need to win the Tenno Sho (Spring), and furthermore..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: With those legs, you must confront an era where speed reigns supreme, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I felt a bit intimidated.
It certainly sounded tough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless, Lady McQueen, my Trainer
and I intend to do just that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wish to be allowed to do so.
Therefore, first of all—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall certainly win the Tenno Sho (Spring).
And then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
With that Shield in hand, I wish to face this era.
All to protect the Mejiro name to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright, you are...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Having my beloved Mejiro falter
would be terribly sad. So, you see~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer and I
shall protect it thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you will lend me a hand,
won't you?
Do not worry, if it is the two of us...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"That is why we met, after all.
Throughout this long, long history."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. That is what I shall tell Grandmother.
That Mejiro will surpass you in speed,
just as we are now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it is nice to invite rare guests once in a while.
It really helps the meeting progress smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... came Mejiro Bright's sudden, out-of-nowhere
vow of certain victory for the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I can't back down now. Not if I want to defeat
the next-generation speedsters waiting ahead."
